attacked_own.village: At bell {b} {actor} attacked your village at ({p},{q}); you lost {x} troops.
attacked_own.army: At bell {b} {actor} attacked your army at ({p},{q}); you lost {x} troops.

kinds.strike: At bell {b} your nation's Strike Order opened at ({p},{q}); troops lost: yours {x}, theirs {y}; your army {took_part}.
kinds.clash_own_win: At bell {b} your army at ({p},{q}) beat {target}: you lost {x}, they lost {y}.
kinds.clash_own_loss: At bell {b} your army at ({p},{q}) lost {x} troops against {target}; they lost {y}.

clash_own_fought.camp: At bell {b} your army at ({p},{q}) fought the camp: you lost {x}, they lost {y}; the camp held.
clash_own_fought.other: At bell {b} your army at ({p},{q}) fought {target}: you lost {x}, they lost {y}; nothing was cleared.

kinds.camp_cleared_own: At bell {b} your army cleared the camp at ({p},{q}).
kinds.camp_taken_by: At bell {b} nation {nation} cleared the camp at ({p},{q}) first.
kinds.threat: At bell {b} nation {nation} sent an army of {m} troops from ({p},{q}); it arrives at bell {a}; its destination is not known.
kinds.dm: At bell {b} {name} sent you a message.
kinds.motion: At bell {b} {name} moved option {k} ({kind}) in your nation's council.

council_result.adopted: At bell {b} your nation's council adopted a Strike Order (its target stays sealed until the strike).
council_result.none: At bell {b} your nation's council adopted nothing.
